inputs:viaf/clusters-2024-08-04.title: VIAF clusters (RDF, N-Triples), 2024-08-04
inputs:viaf/clusters-2024-08-04.description: The yearly VIAF dump of 2024-08-04, all clusters in RDF as N-Triples, sorted by line, as offered on https://viaf.org/en/viaf/data (the only RDF file of the dump). Downloaded on the labs VM 2026-10-17/18 (downloads.viaf.org ignores byte ranges, so interrupted downloads cannot be resumed), copied here, unchanged; SHA-256 checked against the copy on the labs VM. Licence ODC Attribution 1.0 (viaf.org/en/viaf/data).
inputs:viaf/clusters-2024-08-04.note: Not published: a copy of a public source, the input of the dataset viaf (decision 0029).

inputs:cascade/2026-10-26.title: The cascade of the authority datasets, 2026-10-26
inputs:cascade/2026-10-26.origin: jl cascade (src/jl/cascade.py) on the stable versions of 2026-10-26 (footprints 2026-10-26 new; 2014links withdrawn), with the lookups of generators/<slug>/lookup.py: the indexes of the GND, LC, VIAF and GeoNames dumps (the inputs of those generators) and the Wikidata and Wikipedia APIs (answers cached)
inputs:cascade/2026-10-26.description:
-selection.tsv.gz: the selection of each authority dataset (gnd, lc, geonames, viaf, wikidata, dbpedia; source, identifier, current identifier, reason, detail); entities.jsonl.gz, find-

.tsv: the Wikidata answers for the selected items; titles-.jsonl: the Wikipedia answers for the selected titles; cascade.json: rounds and sizes.
inputs:cascade/2026-10-26.note: Not published: the intermediate result the authority generators read (decision 0029).

notes: 213,317 clusters of 231,175 linked VIAF numbers; 17,858 not in the dump; lines that are not valid N-Triples, left out 21; links without an identifier left out (e.g. http://data.bnf.fr/#foaf:Person) 8,450.
